Install Microsoft Edge (Canary) Flatpak

This repository is rebuilt automatically and published with GitHub Pages, and the package bundled is updated daily from the official Microsoft Edge Cannary channel, using GitHub Actions and Flatpak.


Follow the two commands below to add the remote and install the app.

1. Add the remote

flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists --user --no-gpg-verify edgecanary https://${REPO_OWNER}.github.io/${REPO_NAME}/

Repository

  • Name: edgecanary
  • Source: GitHub Pages
  • GPG summary: disabled for this remote

2. Install the app

flatpak install --user edgecanary com.microsoft.EdgeCanary
